title: From lasers to code
paragraphs: I studied physical engineering and nanotechnology at Brno University of Technology and did my PhD in absorption spectroscopy at the Institute of Scientific Instruments of the Czech Academy of Sciences. Somewhere along the way I realised that programming was the part I enjoyed most.

From May 2024 to October 2026 I worked as a software engineer. I started with web scraping in Python and moved on to chatbots that answer from client data. In a small company I worked across the whole stack, from backend and frontend to DevOps, and I was responsible not only for the apps themselves but also for getting them ready for production, including Docker images and Helm charts. I care about code I can take responsibility for once it is deployed.
Outside of work I play chess, floorball and football.
